market_summary: Chips led a broad sell-off on Fri Nov 13 as the market priced Nvidia without Jensen Huang: AMD fell about 10%, Broadcom about 6%, Intel about 5%, Nvidia about 4%. Yahoo had the S&P 500 -0.9% and Nasdaq -1.6% late in the session, Dow -0.2%. October PPI rose 0.3% m/m against 0.4% expected, but is up 6.5% y/y, the most since Nov 2022, so a December Fed hike stays the base case. The 10-yr hit 5.17% intraday, its highest since October; WTI was flat near $88.5 after Thursday's spike. Next week hinges on Nvidia's Tue print under interim CEO Kress, the Anthropic IPO and FOMC minutes; China's open models depend on chips the Nvidia shake-up could put at risk.

ENPH.reason: Down 3.8% as higher yields weigh on rate-sensitive solar; no company-specific news.

LDI.reason: Up 0.9%, but a 10y above 5.1% and Fed-hike odds keep pressure on; delisting risk unchanged.

MU.reason: Down 4.4% with the memory/chip selloff; forward P/E near 4 still prices in a cycle peak.

NFLX.reason: Down 0.7%; no material news since Nov 12.

headlines: Chip rout deepens Fri: AMD -10%, Broadcom -5%, MRVL -6%, MU -4%, NVDA -3% as HSBC cuts Nvidia to Hold.
10y touched 5.17%, highest since October; PPI +6.5% y/y keeps a December Fed hike in play.
META +2% against a Nasdaq down about 1.5%; the only holding clearly green.
OpenAI reportedly raising $15B at $1.25T; SPV mark unchanged at 7.96x.
Next: Nvidia results Tue Nov 17 = Wed morning AEDT; Anthropic IPO prices around Nov 18.
